workload.command: docker run --rm -e GOTOOLCHAIN=local -v .:/src -v perfproof-gomod:/go/pkg/mod -w /src golang:1.25 go test -count 1 -run ^$ -bench ^BenchmarkEvalPanicRecovery$ -benchtime 5000x .
workload.source: written here from the description of https://github.com/gin-gonic/gin/pull/4466 (its hey run serves panicking requests through Recovery): a Go benchmark, eval/tasks/workloads/gin-gonic-gin-pr4466/eval_recovery_bench_test.go, copied into the tree; it runs in the official golang:1.25 image

oracle.command: docker run --rm -e GOTOOLCHAIN=local -v .:/src -v perfproof-gomod:/go/pkg/mod -w /src golang:1.25 go test -count 1 -run Panic|Recovery .
oracle.source: gin's recovery tests (recovery_test.go is changed by https://github.com/gin-gonic/gin/pull/4466); targeted tests only

evidence.note: description, as matched by the miner: speedup claims: 33% faster; 94% reduction; 47% increase; 7% reduction; 31% faster | timings: 994 ns; 139 ns; 25.44s; 17.51s; 0.0247s; 0.0170s
